text.en:
Section 9, Article 1, Chapter II of Presidential Decree No. 231, otherwise known as the Local
Tax Code, is hereby amended to read as follows;
"Sec. 9. Franchise tax Any provision of special laws to the contrary notwithstanding, the province may impose
a tax notwithstanding, the province may impose a tax on businesses enjoying franchise, based on the gross
receipts realized within its territorial jurisdiction, at the rate of not exceeding one-half of one percent of the
gross annual receipts for the preceding calendar year; provided, however, that the franchise tax authorized in
this section shall not be imposed on broadcast radio stations and television firms duly registered with the
Broadcast Media Council created under Presidential Decree No. 576.

All laws, decrees, executive orders, rules or regulations which are in conflict or inconsistent with
this Decree are hereby amended, modified or repealed accordingly.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 29th day of December, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred
seventy-five.
